sloka: गीतिभिः मधुरैः स्निग्धैः मन्त्र आह्वानैः यथार्हतः ।होतारो ददुरावाह्य हविर्भागान् दिवौकसाम् ॥१-१४-९॥
transliteration: gītibhiḥ madhuraiḥ snigdhaiḥ mantra āhvānaiḥ yathārhataḥ ।hotāro dadurāvāhya havirbhāgān divaukasām ॥1-14-9॥

translations.english: During the days (of sacrifice) none felt tired or hungry. There was no brahmin who was not learned or had less than a hundred followers (or disciples).
